entities.summary: Randy Michaels Caballero is a Nicaraguan American professional boxer in the Bantamweight division. Caballero is a former IBF Bantamweight world champion. He lost his title on the scales after being 5 pounds overweight before a scheduled mandatory defence against Lee Haskins.
